lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 한빛 봉사 단체 담당자 김수진입니다.
lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm Kim Sujin, coordinator at Hanbit Volunteer Group.
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. hanbit bongsa danche damdangja gimsujinimnida.
lines.learner: 안녕하세요. 봉사 활동 기간이 궁금해서 전화했어요.
lines.en: Hello. I called to ask about the volunteer period.
lines.roman: annyeonghaseyo. bongsa hwaldong gigani gunggeumhaeseo jeonhwahaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Sure, what would you like to know?
lines.learner: 이 단체가 생긴 지 얼마나 됐어요?
lines.en: How long has this group been around?
lines.roman: i danchega saenggin ji eolmana dwaesseoyo?

lines.beaver: 생긴 지 십 년 됐어요. 봉사해 본 적 있으세요?
lines.beaver_en: It's been ten years. Have you volunteered before?
lines.beaver_roman: saenggin ji sim nyeon dwaesseoyo. bongsahae bon jeok isseuseyo?
lines.learner: 네, 개인 봉사를 시작한 지 2년 됐어요.
lines.en: Yes, it's been two years since I started volunteering on my own.
lines.roman: ne, gaein bongsareul sijakan ji inyeon dwaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. We mainly help the elderly and the weak.
lines.learner: 노약자 지원 활동은 얼마 동안 해야 해요?
lines.en: How long do I need to do the support work?
lines.roman: noyakja jiwon hwaldongeun eolma dongan haeya haeyo?

lines.beaver: 최소 석 달이고, 주 1회 오시면 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: At least three months, and you just need to come once a week.
lines.beaver_roman: choeso seok darigo, ju ilhoe osimyeon dwaeyo.
lines.en: Three months, I see. Do you have branches nationwide?

lines.beaver: 네, 전국에 지점이 스무 곳 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, we have twenty branches across the country.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, jeonguge jijeomi seumu got isseoyo.
lines.learner: 그럼 이사를 가도 전국 어디서나 할 수 있어요?
lines.en: So even if I move, can I do it anywhere in the country?
lines.roman: geureom isareul gado jeonguk eodiseona hal su isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 기간도 그대로 이어져요. 나이가 어떻게 되세요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, your period carries over. How old are you?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, gigando geudaero ieojyeoyo. naiga eotteoke doeseyo?
lines.en: I'm twenty-five. Is the period different for minors?

lines.beaver: 미성년자는 한 달만 해요. 신분증도 꼭 가져오세요.
lines.beaver_en: Minors do just one month. Please bring your ID.
lines.beaver_roman: miseongnyeonjaneun han dalman haeyo. sinbunjeungdo kkok gajyeooseyo.
lines.learner: 네, 신분 확인이 끝나면 언제부터 할 수 있어요?
lines.en: Okay, after the ID check, when can I start?
lines.roman: ne, sinbun hwagini kkeunnamyeon eonjebuteo hal su isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 다음 주부터 돼요. 왜 지원하게 되셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: From next week. Why did you decide to apply?
lines.beaver_roman: daeum jubuteo dwaeyo. wae jiwonhage doesyeosseoyo?
lines.en: I wanted to be of help to the elderly.

lines.beaver: 멋지네요. 그럼 다음 주 월요일에 뵐게요.
lines.beaver_en: That's wonderful. See you next Monday, then.
lines.beaver_roman: meotjineyo. geureom daeum ju woryoire boelgeyo.
lines.en: Okay, I'll do my best. Thank you.
